complete_examples.text: In this part, periodogram algorithm, time-frequency unification method and SPWVD method are introduced to characterize the frequency characteristics of track irregularities, as shown in Fig. 6, from which one can observe that no matter on PSD values or on characteristic frequencies, the results of time-frequency unification method approaches to those derived by periodogram algorithm, however, though SPWVD can also clarify characteristic frequency to a certain extent, it’s assessment on frequency energy densities is at low precision, which will consequently affect the degree of accuracy of the influence coefficients in Eq. (16).
